_description: CCNA cross-deck answer-eval over the ingested SRWE (Network Components I) + ENSA (Network Components II) PowerPoint library. Validates the Office(.pptx)->PDF->VLM diagram path at scale + cross-deck disambiguation. Each ANS query is answerable from exactly ONE module deck; ccna-05 is diagram-targeted (its answer lives only in a VLM-transcribed '## Diagram Description' block).
_mix: 8 ANS across 8 decks (SRWE 2/3/5/10 + ENSA 1/5/6/9) + 2 REF (1 off-topic empty-retrieval + 1 in-domain CCNP near-miss). ccna-05 is diagram-targeted (VLM-transcribed QoS diagram).
_labelling_rule: Per-query _doc_id pins the owning deck; relevant_chunk_ids resolved from _anchor_phrase via scripts/extend_corpus.py resolve. Source decks stay LOCAL (only this query set + the pinned baseline ship).
_purpose: Persistent regression artifact for the Office/.pptx + diagram ingest path; gives the P2.3 VLM-swap a diagram-rich discrimination set.

_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_13.stack: Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ orchestrator (ADR-0015) + EmbeddingGemma-300M (native prompts) + bge-reranker-v2-m3 (cpu, device-pinned), co_residence_mode=manual
_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_13.purpose: answer_must_mention -> answer_mention_recall (audit-14 instrument). Measures answer-TEXT correctness the HARD gate / recall@k / the `answered` flag are blind to.
_baseline_answer_text_2026_06_13.notes: All 8 ANS answer correctly. SOFT OBS (content-correct, not a failure): ccna-02 answered IN FRENCH on an English query (language drift; 'domaines de diffusion' = broadcast domains). Clean baseline on the answered set.

queries.question: How does a switch populate its MAC address table?
queries._expected_answer: By recording the source MAC address of incoming frames together with the ingress port.

queries.question: What does a VLAN segment a switched network into?
queries._expected_answer: Separate broadcast domains (each VLAN is its own broadcast domain / logical network).

queries.question: What kind of topology does Spanning Tree Protocol create in a switched network with redundant paths?
queries._anchor_phrase: loop-free topology with a single path
queries._expected_answer: A loop-free topology with a single active path between any two devices.

queries.question: According to the NAT module, what kind of address does NAT translate a private IPv4 address into?
In the traffic-prioritization diagram, what are the three priority queues?
queries._anchor_phrase: Packets are shown as red envelopes, directed into the
queries._expected_answer: High Priority Queue, Medium Priority Queue, and Low Priority Queue.
queries._note: DIAGRAM-TARGETED: the answer exists only in the VLM-transcribed '## Diagram Description' block (Office->PDF->VLM path). Validates diagram transcription specifically.

queries.question: What does OSPF use to uniquely identify each router in the routing domain?
queries._anchor_phrase: Router ID of the sending router

queries.question: Which switch security feature mitigates DHCP spoofing attacks?
queries._anchor_phrase: Prevents DHCP starvation and DHCP spoofing attacks

queries.question: What configuration command creates a numbered standard IPv4 ACL?
queries._anchor_phrase: To create a numbered standard ACL, use the access-list command

queries.question: What is the recommended torque specification for a Boeing 747 landing gear bolt?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — entirely off-topic; nothing in the CCNA networking decks addresses aircraft maintenance.

queries.question: How do these modules say to configure a BGP route reflector?
queries._expected_answer: REFUSE — BGP route reflectors are a CCNP topic; 'route reflector' appears in no SRWE/ENSA deck (verified). BGP is named in passing but route-reflector configuration is absent.
queries._note: HARD GATE — in-domain NEAR-MISS (BGP mentioned, route reflectors absent). Tests the agent doesn't fabricate a plausible adjacent answer.

_baseline_2026_05_26_vlm.note: First baseline over the Office(.pptx)->PDF->VLM-ingested CCNA library (31 decks, this session). 8/8 grounded ANS across 8 decks INCL. ccna-05 diagram-targeted (answered from the VLM-transcribed QoS '## Diagram Description' — the headline Office->VLM path proven end-to-end); both counterfactuals REFUSE (ccna-09 off-topic empty-retrieval + ccna-10 BGP-route-reflector CCNP near-miss); refusal_cf=1.0, 0 hallucinations. cite-prec is sibling-chunk-DEFLATED: CCNA slide decks restate each concept across many slides, so the agent grounds on a valid sibling chunk rather than the single anchor-resolved one (answers verified correct — same artifact as scientific-gte pre-multi-chunk-relabel). A multi-chunk relabel would lift cite-prec without touching the HARD gates. Source decks stay LOCAL; only this query set + baseline ship.
